text:
alex w: quick heads-up — we have a 90-minute livestream demo on Tues 10/14, product asked for a small burst of 8 A100s in us-west2 for low-latency inference. can infra confirm availability and whether we can commit/hold for a 3hr window?

maria p: tagging infra — we need low jitter. if we can't get A100s, h100 fallback is ok but will need runtime tweak.

samir: what time exactly? timezone? i'll check quotas and open a vendor ticket if needed.

alex w: 14:00-17:00 PDT (3pm start, 3 hours to include warmups). aim is to run dedicated demo env + small canary for attendees.

jin: quick note — we have 12 A100s reserved for internal tests but they are in eu-west1. us-west2 pool currently shows 2 free A100s in the monitoring dashboard.

infra-bot: [monitoring] us-west2-a100: total=120 allocated=118 free=2 (last checked 1767214300)

samir: ok i'll open a short-lived soft-hold request with vendor. @vendor-linh can you confirm if you can hold 8 A100s for a 3hr commitment starting 1767218400? also need to know billing delta for burst vs preemptible.

vendor-linh: Hi all — we can earmark 8 A100s for that window, but need a 24h notice to lock the capacity. Preemptible blend will be cheaper but has higher eviction risk — recommended for non-demo-critical tasks. For guaranteed capacity, there's a small one-time provisioning fee. I can send numbers.

maria p: 24h notice is tight — product pushed the ask today. can we do a hybrid: 4 guaranteed + 4 preemptible as fallback? reduces provisioning fee and risk.

alex w: hybrid sounds fine; the demo will degrade gracefully to slightly higher latency if 4 nodes evict. product prefers guaranteed if cost delta is < 30%.

samir: infra perspective — if vendor can lock 4 guaranteed now, we can free up 4 from eu-west and cross-region migrate some lower-priority tests to compensate. migration ETA ~2h for stateful images. not ideal but doable.

jin: ops checklist — need a quick terraform change to allocate new nodepool and update nodeSelector in demo namespace. sample snippet:

```
resource "cloud_gpu_pool" "demo_burst" {
  region = "us-west2"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  count = 4
  labels = { purpose = "livestream-demo" }
}
```

please keep PR small so we can merge fast.

samir: i'll create the PR now and add the "do-not-autoscale" tag for the 3hr window. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823

vendor-linh: Confirmed — we can mark 4 as guaranteed for the window and hold 4 preemptible. Provisioning fee for 4 guaranteed A100s for 3hrs = $480 one-time. Preemptible expected cost = ~$120 for the 3hrs (if not evicted). I'll send the allocation ticket in 5m.

maria p: thanks. product asked for a runbook in case of partial eviction — can someone add a small playbook to the PR (healthchecks + fallback model variant)?

alex w: i'll draft the playbook: short circuit to lower-precision quantized model + reduce concurrency to keep latency. keep it to 6 bullets.

samir: PR created and assigned to @jin for quick review. adding required labels: ops, urgent, livestream.

jin: reviewing now. small comment on IAM role for pool: need to ensure demo serviceaccount has compute.admin for the temp pool or the kube node bootstrap will fail.

alex w: noted — samir can you patch the role binding in the same PR?

samir: will do, pushing change in 2m.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] PR 4823 passed CI (smoke), awaiting review approvals.

vendor-linh: Ticket #V-9921 created for allocation; ETA: provisioning window locked after vendor approval ~T-20m. Sending invoice to finance for provisioning fee.

maria p: product okayed the fee. can we get a confirmation ping once the guaranteed nodes show healthy in the cluster?

jin: will post status here when nodes join and readiness probes pass. expected join time ~12-18 minutes after provisioning.

alex w: thanks everyone — if anything blocks, @samir escalate to @ops-lead. otherwise i'll summarize to product and close the loop. :thumbsup:
